title: PlaybackProgressPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'playback.progress'. STATE.md P2.8/deliverable E (websocket-presence lane): now-playing presence signal, emitted from the heartbeat path (PUT /progress/{itemId} with a sessionId, docs/PLAYBACK.md §9) AT MOST ONCE PER 30 SECONDS PER SESSION (plan §6.3 — never row-per-tick; see packages/db/src/query/playback-sessions.ts's last_progress_event_at_ms throttle). Distinct from progress.updated (which fires on every progress upsert, keyed by user+item with no device/session context) — this one carries the session/device identity admin surfaces and the home-row now-playing pulse (P2.11) need to render 'user X is watching item Y on device Z'.

durationMs.description: Snapshot of the played file's duration when known (mirrors Progress.durationMs); null when the client never supplied one.
